transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. [Name]. To start, can you tell me what's been bringing you in to see me today?

Hi, Doctor. Well, my wife is the one who made the appointment. What finally scared her is that... I keep hearing things. I keep hearing water running, and these men whispering inside the walls when nobody’s there. And sometimes I look out and see this dark, wet patch spreading across the hallway. But even after I’ve gone over and checked it, the floor is totally dry. So... she said I needed to come see someone.
Have you been using any alcohol, recreational drugs, or new medications recently?
No, I haven't. I don't drink, and I haven't taken any drugs or started any new medications. It's just... this is just happening on its own.
How long have you been experiencing these sounds and visual disturbances—did they start suddenly a few days ago, or have they been going on for weeks or months?

Well, it's been going on for a while now. About seven months, I think. It started back during the winter freeze... the pipes burst and the house repairs just turned into this huge mess that I couldn't get out from under. That's when I first started noticing it.
Have you had any recent illnesses, head injuries, fevers, or been diagnosed with any new medical conditions around the time these experiences started?

No, nothing like that. I haven't been sick, no fevers, and I haven't hit my head or anything. I haven't been to a regular doctor in a while, honestly, so no new diagnoses either. Physically, I've been fine. It's just... my mind, I guess.
Since these experiences started about seven months ago, have you noticed any changes in your ability to work, keep up with daily responsibilities, or interact with family and friends?

Yeah, things have definitely changed. I... I just can't keep up with anything anymore. I've stopped dealing with basic repairs around the house, and I haven't been paying the bills or keeping up with any of my commitments. My wife has had to take over all the decisions I used to handle myself. It actually got so bad recently that she had to call a crisis team... I just couldn't cooperate when they came to do a safety inspection at the house. I just couldn't do it.

Besides the voices and visions, have you noticed any changes in your emotions or motivation—like feeling flat or numb, losing interest in things you used to enjoy, or wanting to avoid being around people?

Yeah, definitely. I just... I don't have the interest for anything anymore. I used to be the guy who always showed up for soccer, or I'd be out brewing beer in the garage... I even used to help out down at the fire department. But now... I don't know. It all just feels completely pointless. I just can't make myself care enough to go do any of it.
